user.title: Install HA Themes
user.description: Installs the themes into your themes directory and loads the support module that applies their fonts and icon colors on every page. Pick a theme in your profile afterwards.

themes_not_loaded.title: HA Themes cannot load its themes
themes_not_loaded.description:
The themes were installed into `{directory}`, but Home Assistant does not load themes from that directory. Make `frontend: themes:` in `configuration.yaml` read as follows, restart Home Assistant, then reload this integration:

```yaml
{configuration}
```

themes_reload_failed.title: HA Themes could not reload the themes
themes_reload_failed.description:
Home Assistant refused to reload the themes, so the installed themes may be missing or outdated. Fix the error below in `configuration.yaml` or in the theme files it includes, then reload this integration:

```
{error}
```
